study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter observational registry
exposure: Maternal co-morbidities (heart disease, renal disease, connective tissue disease, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, diabetes, asthma, anemia)
cohort: 73,096 women with known gestational age who had prior uterine surgery or primary cesarean delivery
finding: Women with cardiac disease, renal disease, connective tissue disease, and preeclampsia spectrum disorders were at increased risk for critical care interventions during delivery hospitalization.
